historical_growth.growth_rate_source: forward: base-case FY2025-FY2030 USD revenue CAGR (management +5-6% cc guidance haircut for the Sept-2026 Phase III failures and 2028 IRA negotiation). Historical series are not usable as the anchor (see warning).
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (-8.1% 3yr, -4.0% 5yr) diverges by far more than 30% from revenue (+2.6%/+2.3%) and EPS (+31%/+15%). None of the historical series is clean: FY2020-FY2022 revenue includes Sandoz (spun Oct-2023), so the 3/5yr revenue CAGRs understate the innovative-medicines business (+9.5% p.a. FY2023-25 continuing); equity shrank through the Sandoz distribution and ~USD 45bn of buybacks over five years; FY2022 EPS was depressed by impairments and FY2021 inflated by the Roche-stake gain. Selected growth is forward-looking instead.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF (reported FCF - SBC) CAGRs equal reported FCF CAGRs to one decimal: SBC is ~6-7% of FCF and growing in line, so no growing share of FCF is being paid in stock. FCF growth since FY2022 (+10.5%/yr) was flattered by the Sandoz exit (lower-margin generics) and by Entresto peaking in FY2024-25 and will not repeat in FY2026.

scenario_narratives.base: Novartis grows through the largest patent expiry in its history, but below its own +5-6% cc 2025-30 algorithm (~4.4% USD here). Entresto (US generics since Jul-2025, EU exclusivity lapsing Nov-2026), Promacta and Tasigna erode on schedule and are absorbed by Kisqali, Kesimpta, Pluvicto, Scemblix, Leqvio, Fabhalta and Rhapsido (all growing 30-90% cc in Q2 2026). Cash margins dip ~1.4pp in FY2026 in line with the guided core-operating-income decline, and recover to the FY2025 level by FY2029; the 2028 IRA negotiation on Cosentyx/Kisqali/Xolair and the Dec-2025 US pricing agreement stop them going higher. The Sept-2026 Phase III failures are treated as a haircut to the growth rate and a standing ~3% of sales BD/M&A charge to keep the pipeline full, not as a thesis break.
scenario_narratives.bull: Management's medium-term guidance is met and then some: Kisqali's six-year eBC overall-survival data and pediatric exclusivity extend its run, Pluvicto moves earlier in prostate cancer, Scemblix takes first-line CML, Fabhalta's IgAN approval broadens its renal franchise, and remibrutinib adds MS to CSU/CIndU. Sales compound ~6.5% USD through 2030, mix lifts cash margins to ~43.5%, and less of the growth has to be bought (BD 2% of sales).
scenario_narratives.bear: Two Phase III failures in one month, one of them the lead asset of the just-closed USD 12bn Avidity deal, turn out to be a pattern: acquired pipeline under-delivers and replacing it costs more (BD 5% of sales). EU Entresto generics bite hard in 2027, Medicare negotiated prices from 2028 hit Kisqali and Cosentyx, and US MFN-style pricing compresses the growth brands. Sales are flat in FY2027 and grow ~2% thereafter, cash margins fall to ~36.5%, and the market pays a no-growth-pharma 12x FCF.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on an unlevered cash-EBITDA build, charging SBC once (expensed, flat count), in-licensing and a recurring BD/M&A allowance as capex, and leases plus NCI in the bridge. The central question is whether Novartis's growth brands and bought-in pipeline outrun the 2025-27 patent cliff and 2028 US price negotiation; the scenarios span that tension rather than extrapolating the FY2023-25 Entresto-peak growth.
key_risks_to_valuation: Entresto EU exclusivity loss (Nov-2026) and the pace of 2027 erosion
Pipeline execution after the Sept-2026 pelacarsen and del-desiran Phase III failures; value of the USD 12bn Avidity acquisition
Medicare negotiated prices on Cosentyx, Kisqali and Xolair from 2028; MFN-style US pricing commitments
BD/M&A intensity: the model charges 3% of sales base; a return to ~USD 10bn+ annual deal spend without matching growth is value-destructive
Net debt of ~USD 41bn (incl. leases) after Avidity: leverage is modest (~1.8x EBITDA) but the buyback and dividend are now partly debt-funded
Terminal value capped at 15x FCF in base; the cap binds, so the value is sensitive to the cap rather than to terminal growth

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 121.57-170.46
data_sources.financials: NVS_Metrics.csv (core_metrics from 20-F/Annual Reports FY2014-FY2025 and interims); FY2025 Annual Report cash flow statement and changes in equity (SBC, equity-award taxes, provisions payments, intangible purchases); H1 2026 Condensed Interim Financial Report and Q2 2026 Financial Report (SEC 6-K filed 2026-07-21, accession 0001114448-26-000012) for net debt, lease liabilities, NCI, shares outstanding and reaffirmed FY2026 guidance
data_sources.qualitative: NVS_Analysis.json (2026-10 analysis: patent cliff, pipeline failures Sept-2026, Avidity acquisition, US pricing, medium-term guidance)

inputs.share_count_basis: 1,900.7m shares outstanding at 2026-06-30 (H1 2026 interim, note 4) plus ~9m dilutive equity awards (Q2 2026 diluted 1,914m vs basic 1,905m weighted). Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows; the up-to-USD 10bn buyback (USD 5.6bn remaining at 30 June) is the cash mechanism that keeps the count flat and is value-neutral here.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 20-F/Annual Report cash flow: equity-based compensation of Novartis equity plans USD 1,096m; plus USD 113m 'Taxes on treasury share transactions' (statement of changes in equity, NVS_Annual_FY2025.txt:3877). No combined company figure, so the two lines are summed. H1 2026: USD 616m SBC on USD 27.5bn sales (2.2%).
inputs.interest_income_note: Not stripped: Novartis is a net-DEBT company (USD 39.4bn financial net debt at 2026-06-30), so there is no cash pile to double-count. Interest received (USD 310m FY2025) and paid sit inside reported FCF, but the forward build is unlevered (EBITDA-based), so neither enters the flows.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-02T20:00:02Z regular close (Yahoo chart API; Friday close, latest regular session before the 2026-10-04 valuation date)
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD build (flows and quote both USD). Cost of equity ~7.6%: US 10y ~4.3% + beta ~0.65 (large-cap pharma, defensive) x 5.0% ERP. After-tax cost of debt ~3.9% (Aa3/AA-, 2026 USD bonds ~4.6% pre-tax, ~16% tax). Market weights ~E USD 270bn / D USD 41bn (~13% debt) -> ~7.1%; rounded to 7.25%. Single WACC across all scenarios: pipeline and pricing risk is charged in the scenario paths and weights, not as a rate premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment A: lease liabilities (USD 1,663m non-current + 274m current at 2026-06-30) ADDED to net debt; no lease charge in the flows (IFRS 16 EBITDA excludes lease cost; lease principal of ~USD 270m/yr sits in financing and is not deducted from FCF). One treatment only.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI of USD 404m at book (2026-06-30 balance sheet) deducted in the equity bridge; flows are consolidated. NCI share of profit is immaterial (USD -14m H1 2026).
inputs.net_debt_build: Company net debt USD 39,387m at 2026-06-30 = current + non-current financial debts and derivatives (9,588 + 37,489 = 47,077) less cash 7,616 and marketable securities/time deposits/derivatives 74; plus lease liabilities 1,937 = 41,324. The jump from USD 21.9bn at Dec-2025 is the USD 12.0bn Avidity acquisition (closed 2026-02-27, bridge refinanced with USD 11bn + EUR 1.7bn bonds), USD 2.7bn Pikavation/Excellergy, the USD 9.1bn dividend and USD 3.1bn treasury-share outflows, against USD 8.9bn H1 FCF. The pending Myricx Bio acquisition (H2 2026 close, price undisclosed) is not deducted.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon (FY2026-FY2035), scenario-weighted. Novartis is a pure-play innovative-medicines operating company (Sandoz spun off Oct-2023), so the operating-company row of the routing table applies; Swiss domicile but USD reporting and a 1:1 USD ADS, so no currency or ADS-ratio adjustment. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY entry, no prior DCF). ANCHORS: revenue base FY2025 (USD 54,532m) because FY2026 guidance is framed against it; balance sheet and share count are the LATEST filing, the H1 2026 interim (6-K 2026-07-21, nvs-20260630-99_2.htm), pulled from SEC EDGAR because no 2026 interim was in Extracted/. COMPONENT CALIBRATION: EBITDA in the paths is CASH EBITDA before SBC: IFRS EBITDA 22,919 + SBC 1,096 = 24,015 (44.0%) less the recurring ~USD 1.1-1.5bn/yr 'payments out of provisions' (legal settlements, restructuring; 1,483 FY2025, 1,107 FY2024) and similar OCF leakage that EBITDA does not see -> ~41.1% FY2025. D&A 8% of sales (amortisation 3,197 + depreciation ~1,300, ex impairments) only shields tax. CAPEX = PP&E (2.8%) + purchases of intangible assets / in-licensing milestones (4.3%, USD 2.35bn FY2025, which Novartis's own FCF definition EXCLUDES) + a recurring business-development/M&A allowance (3% of sales base). Novartis has spent ~USD 5bn/yr on acquisitions over a decade (AveXis, The Medicines Co, MorphoSys, Chinook, Tourmaline, Avidity) and the forward growth path depends on that replenishment; charging zero would credit acquired growth without its price, charging the full ~9% assumes no M&A creates value. FY2025 check: this build reproduces FY2025 unlevered owner FCF of ~USD 14.8bn before the BD allowance (reported FCF 17,596 - SBC 1,209 - intangibles 2,352 + net interest ~700). CASH TAX: FY2025 taxes paid 2,562 on component EBIT ~16.9bn = 15.1%; ramps to 16.5% (Pillar Two 15% floor, Swiss/US mix). WORKING CAPITAL: receivables + inventory exceed payables (~16% of sales), so capture is NEGATIVE on revenue growth. BUYBACKS: a funded repurchaser (USD 9.2bn FY2025, USD 2.8bn H1 2026), so the flat count is being paid for, not just a convention.

bear.narrative: The cliff is deeper and the refill weaker: EU Entresto generics take share faster in 2027, the Sept-2026 failures (pelacarsen in CV, del-desiran from the USD 12bn Avidity deal) mark a pattern rather than noise, and 2028 Medicare negotiated prices on Kisqali and Cosentyx plus MFN-style US pricing compress the very brands meant to offset the cliff. Sales are flat in FY2027 and grow ~2% thereafter, margins slide to ~36.5%, BD spend rises to 5% of sales just to stand still, and the market prices Novartis like a no-growth pharma at 12x FCF.

base.growth_rates_rationale: FY2026 +2.5% USD = guided low-single-digit cc growth (H1 -2% cc, Q2 +1% cc; FX +1pp at mid-July rates). FY2027 +4%: EU Entresto exclusivity lapses Nov-2026 and Promacta/Tasigna erosion completes, absorbed by Kisqali/Kesimpta/Pluvicto/Scemblix/Leqvio/Fabhalta/Rhapsido. FY2028-30 +5%. FY2025-30 CAGR ~4.4% USD vs management's +5-6% cc: haircut for the two Sept-2026 Phase III misses (pelacarsen, del-desiran) and Medicare negotiated prices on Cosentyx/Kisqali/Xolair from 2028. +3% thereafter as the 2030s LOE wave (Cosentyx, Kesimpta, Kisqali) offsets new launches.
base.ebitda_margin_rationale: Cash EBITDA pre-SBC (see inputs.notes). FY2025 ~41.1%; FY2026 -1.4pp mirrors guided low-single-digit core operating income DECLINE on +2-3% sales (core OI ~USD 21.6bn vs 21.9bn); H1 2026 core margin 39.4% (-2.7pp), Q2 41.2%. Recovers to ~41% by FY2029 as high-margin growth brands scale; no expansion beyond the FY2025 level because 2028 IRA pricing and the Dec-2025 US pricing agreement cap US price.
base.capex_rationale: PP&E 2.8% + intangible purchases 4.3% + BD/M&A allowance 3.0% of sales.
base.narrative: Novartis grows through the largest patent expiry in its history but below its own algorithm: the growth brands absorb Entresto/Promacta/Tasigna, margins dip in FY2026 and recover to the FY2025 level, and pipeline replenishment keeps costing ~3% of sales a year in BD on top of in-licensing.

bull.narrative: Management's algorithm is delivered: +6% cc 2025-30 plus modest FX, with Kisqali's eBC overall-survival data and pediatric exclusivity, Pluvicto pre-taxane/mHSPC, Scemblix first-line, Fabhalta renal and Rhapsido CSU/CIndU each reaching the upper half of their USD 3-10bn peak ranges, and remibrutinib's positive MS Phase III opening a further indication. Mix lifts margins to ~43.5% (core margin mid-40s), the pipeline needs less bought-in replenishment (BD 2% of sales), and the market keeps paying a premium multiple for a pure-play with visible growth.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: September 2026 delivered two Phase III misses (pelacarsen; del-desiran, the lead asset of the USD 12bn Avidity acquisition), a direct negative read on M&A-driven pipeline replenishment exactly when the growth brands must offset the largest patent expiry in company history, with 2028 IRA negotiation still to land. Base 50%: FY2026 guidance was reaffirmed in July and Q2 returned to growth, so the central path is the guided one, haircut. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent things to go right at once (multiple label expansions, no further pipeline misses, benign US pricing).

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
